parameters.offsets: all starts for which the full active page fits within the chapter

source.section: Self-Reliance, after chapter heading and before III.Compensation; includes epigraph and repeated essay title
source.tokenization: ASCII letter words only; punctuation/numbers omitted; greedy GP encoding within each word, never across words

null_calibration.model: Exact rune counts and stream doublets, independent rejection shuffles; full key/offset/sign/skip scan in each draw.

limits: One selected essay and digital edition, two explicit encoding conventions; no other text, backward key or arbitrary F mask is tested.
The essay is a speculative thematic candidate; no source claims it is an established Cicada key.
Non-ASCII Latin letters are excluded from ASCII-word tokenization and explicitly inventoried in source metadata.
39 null draws cannot establish significance after55page correction; scores alone never certify decryption.
